policy: Instrument displays are measurement-neutral (plan §2.4, D7; handoff G-1). A display may show configured settings, status, a readout whose provenance is "simulator-generated" where the runtime produces one, and, after entry, the learner's own value labelled "Your entry". It never shows an invented reading. src/studio3d/adapters/instrumentDisplay.ts implements these policies (M3).

balance-status-and-entry.note: The runtime does not simulate balance mass; weighing's input is a studentResponse (decision U4).

photometer-settings-status-and-entry.note: The runtime tracks photometer calibration and blank readiness, not %T; %T is a studentResponse.

simulator-readout.note: For instruments whose readout carries provenance "simulator-generated" (the pH meter, in later packs).
